note: Frozen. Each case runs on a fresh database from today's schema (schema_version 4). See ../README.md for the format.

cases.name: project-state/load-missing
cases.description: No row for the project: null.

cases.name: project-state/save-full-and-load
cases.description: Every tab type, every active id, pane layout, orders, starred ids and a saved workflow whose result rows hold bigint, bytes, a decimal, a literal {$sq} object and non-finite numbers.
cases.notes: connectionTabs, activeConnectionTabId and the extensionsDuckdb fields are not stored. Schema and data tabs store tableName in `name` too. Workflow tabs are stored with tab_type 'canvas'. The load returns savedWorkflows decoded with fromStorable, recorded here with toStorable's tags again.

cases.name: project-state/save-minimal-and-load
cases.description: Only the required fields; every optional list and id left out. Loads fill in [] and null, activeDashboardTabId null, paneLayout absent.

cases.name: project-state/save-replaces-tabs-and-workflows
cases.description: A second save replaces the row (INSERT OR REPLACE), all tabs and all canvases.

cases.name: project-state/workflow-without-id
cases.description: A saved workflow with no id gets `workflow-<random uuid>` as its row id (masked in this fixture).
cases.notes: The id is random; compare it by pattern (`workflow-` + a v4 UUID).

cases.name: project-state/load-stored-quirks
cases.description: Rows the save path never writes: a query tab with only shared_query_id, a starter tab with NULL type and closable, unknown tab types, bad JSON in tab_order, connection_order, starred ids and pane_layout, and bad or null canvases.

steps.sql:
INSERT INTO project_state (project_id, active_view, tab_order, connection_order, starred_shared_query_ids, starred_shared_dashboard_ids, pane_layout)
       VALUES ('p1', 'canvas', '{bad', 'null', 'nope', '[1', '{bad')
INSERT INTO tabs (id, project_id, tab_type, name, shared_query_id) VALUES ('q1', 'p1', 'query', 'Shared', 'shared-q')
INSERT INTO tabs (id, project_id, tab_type, name, saved_query_id, shared_query_id) VALUES ('q2', 'p1', 'query', 'Both', 'saved-q', 'shared-q')
INSERT INTO tabs (id, project_id, tab_type, name) VALUES ('st', 'p1', 'starter', 'Starter')
INSERT INTO tabs (id, project_id, tab_type, name, closable) VALUES ('st2', 'p1', 'starter', 'Starter2', 2)
INSERT INTO tabs (id, project_id, tab_type, name) VALUES ('v', 'p1', 'visualize', 'Viz')
INSERT INTO tabs (id, project_id, tab_type, name) VALUES ('stat', 'p1', 'statistics', 'NoConn')
INSERT INTO tabs (id, project_id, tab_type, name) VALUES ('ct', 'p1', 'create_table', 'NoDef')
INSERT INTO tabs (id, project_id, tab_type, name) VALUES ('s', 'p1', 'schema', 'NoTable')
INSERT INTO saved_canvases (id, project_id, data) VALUES ('bad', 'p1', '{bad')
INSERT INTO saved_canvases (id, project_id, data) VALUES ('null', 'p1', 'null')
INSERT INTO saved_canvases (id, project_id, data) VALUES ('notag', 'p1', '{"id":"notag","x":{"$sq":"bigint"}}')
INSERT INTO saved_canvases (id, project_id, data) VALUES ('badtag', 'p1', '{"id":"badtag","x":{"$sq":"bigint","v":"abc"}}')
INSERT INTO saved_canvases (id, project_id, data) VALUES ('ok', 'p1', '{"id":"ok","name":"Ok"}')

cases.notes: active_view 'canvas' is returned as is: only upgradeSchema rewrites it. connection_order 'null' parses to null, and the load returns null for connectionOrder (safeJsonParse returns the parsed null, not the fallback). A {$sq} object without `v` is not a tag and loads as a plain object (recorded wrapped in a json tag, as toStorable would); a tag whose value doesn't decode (bigint "abc") makes fromStorable throw, and the load drops that canvas.

cases.name: project-state/remove
cases.description: remove deletes the state row, its tabs and its canvases; the other project keeps its own.

cases.name: project-state/save-missing-project
cases.description: The project doesn't exist: the batch fails on the foreign key and rolls back as a whole.

cases.name: project-state/duplicate-tab-id-rolls-back
cases.description: Two tabs with the same id violate the tabs primary key; the whole batch (state row included) rolls back and the earlier state survives.
